name: qq
description: QQ 机器人：官方出站 WebSocket 双向对话、富媒体收发、用户白名单与 AI qq 工具；支持系统或插件 TTS 语音自动回复，可选择引擎、音色及语音和文字组合。密钥加密存储。
descriptionEn: QQ Bot with outbound WebSocket chat, rich media, access control, and an AI qq tool. Automatic voice replies use the shared TTS center with selectable engines and voices, optional text, and encrypted credentials.
author: pi-web-ui

contextmenu.project.label: 设为 QQ 机器人根目录
contextmenu.project.labelEn: Set as QQ bot workspace root
contextmenu.project.hint: 把该项目设为 QQ 机器人执行指令的工作空间根目录
contextmenu.project.hintEn: Use this project as the workspace root for QQ bot commands

settings.label: 默认工作空间根目录
settings.hint: QQ 机器人执行指令的工作目录；空 = 跟随当前网页项目根目录
settings.hintEn: Working directory for QQ bot commands; empty = follow the current web project root

settings.label: 默认模型
settings.hint: 选择已配置的模型；空 = 跟随全局默认模型
settings.hintEn: Pick a configured model; empty = follow the global default model

settings.label: 默认思考强度
settings.hint: 思考强度档位（off…max）；空 = 跟随全局设置
settings.hintEn: Thinking level (off…max); empty = follow the global setting

settings.label: 强行注入电脑端当前打开的会话（遥控器模式）
settings.labelEn: Force-inject the session open on the desktop (remote-control mode)
settings.hint: 开 = 手机 QQ 消息直接注入电脑当前打开的会话（当遥控器用）；关（推荐）= 独立专属 QQ 对话，互不干扰
settings.hintEn: On = QQ messages are injected into the session currently open on the desktop (use it as a remote); off (recommended) = a dedicated QQ conversation that never interferes

settings.label: 自动回复方式
settings.hint: text = 文字；voice = 语音；both = 语音和文字。单聊/群聊支持语音，频道及语音失败时发送文字。
settings.hintEn: text = text; voice = voice; both = voice and text. Direct and group chats support voice; channels (and voice failures) send text.

settings.label: 语音回复引擎
settings.hint: 统一 TTS 中心的引擎 ID；在 QQ 工作台高级设置中可从已注册引擎选择，例如 builtin、doubao-tts、deepseek-tts。
settings.hintEn: Engine ID from the shared TTS center; pick from registered engines in the QQ workbench advanced settings, e.g. builtin, doubao-tts, deepseek-tts.

settings.label: 语音回复音色
settings.hint: 所选引擎的音色 ID；留空使用默认音色，QQ 工作台可列出并选择所有已注册音色。
settings.hintEn: Speaker ID of the selected engine; empty uses the default voice. The QQ workbench lists and selects all registered voices.

settings.label: 语音回复语速
settings.hint: 0.5–2 倍速；不支持语速调节的引擎使用固定语速。
settings.hintEn: 0.5–2x speed; engines without rate control use a fixed rate.

settings.label: 执行超时提醒(秒)
settings.hint: AI 执行超过此时长先发送“还在执行”，任务完成后再追发结果
settings.hintEn: After this long the bot first confirms it is still working, then posts the result once the task finishes

settings.label: 接收图片/文件落地
settings.hint: QQ 发来的图片/语音/视频/文件下载后存到工作区 .pi-qq-media/，AI 可用 read 直接查看；关 = 只收占位文字
settings.hintEn: Images/voice/video/files from QQ are downloaded into the workspace .pi-qq-media/ so the AI can read them directly; off = only placeholder text

settings.label: 广播通知子频道 ID
settings.hint: AI 提问与任务完成时推送通知的 QQ 频道子频道 ID；留空默认使用默认发送子频道
settings.hintEn: Guild sub-channel ID that receives notifications for AI questions and finished tasks; empty = the default sending sub-channel

settings.label: AI 提问待确认时发送频道通知
settings.labelEn: Notify the channel when a question waits for confirmation
settings.hint: 开 = AI 调用 ask_user_question 等待用户确认时，向私人频道推送待办提醒
settings.hintEn: On = push a reminder to the private channel when the AI calls ask_user_question and waits for confirmation

settings.label: AI 任务执行完成时发送频道通知
settings.labelEn: Notify the channel when a task finishes
settings.hint: 开 = 任务执行完毕后，向私人频道推送结果摘要与完成提醒
settings.hintEn: On = push a result summary and completion reminder to the private channel after a task finishes
